announcements.title: Local Backups & Quick Restores
announcements.message: Checkpoint stores your ledger locally on your device. You can export a full JSON backup or restore past records at any time under Settings.

announcements.title: Welcome to Checkpoint v2.1
announcements.message: High-density ledger designed for raid runners, boosters, and creators. Offline-first and bi-directional Toman/Gold engine.

announcements.title: Added Team Pots and cut split support
announcements.message: Add work Pots and cut split support to your raid runs. Check out the new features in the Nodra integration.
